_meta.PROVISIONAL: Every MC cross section here is PROVISIONAL (D-2026-10-05-A: first look). Collected 2026-10-05 by the AI from public sources (LHC WG notes, 13.6 TeV CMS/ATLAS papers, public repositories quoting XSDB / GenXSecAnalyzer); XSDB itself (CERN login) and the CERN twikis (robots.txt) were not read. Five keys are 13 TeV values scaled to 13.6 TeV (xsec_ref starts with SCALED_FROM_13TEV). Plots made with this file must say 'provisional cross sections'. Review each entry before any result.
_meta.convention: Same as data/samples_2017UL.json: cross_section_fb = target production sigma when a separate br field is used (case inclusive_x_br); for generator decay-filtered / forced-decay samples stored with br=1, cross_section_fb is the sample-level effective sigma (case sample_effective). sigma_eff = cross_section_fb x br x kfactor; kfactor = 1.0 for all. Data: all null.
_meta.weight_formula: base_weight = lumi_fb_inv x cross_section_fb x br x kfactor / sumGenW (runs.genEventSumw of the prescan: the Runs tree of our skimmed ntuples keeps the unskimmed sum).
_meta.branching_ratios: B(W->had) = 0.6741 (PDG 2024 summary tables, 67.41 +- 0.27 %); B(W->lnu, e+mu+tau) = 0.3259 = 1 - 0.6741 (as the 2017 table); B(H->bb) = 0.5824 (mH = 125.00, LHC Higgs WG / YR4, as the 2017 table); B(Z->bb) = 0.1512 (PDG 2024, 15.12 +- 0.05 %; the 2017 table used 0.15)
